description: Source code for a Go package implementing a client for a documentation-related RPC service, including process management, JSON message handling, and communication with an external process.

classes.name: docsPiClient
classes.description: Manages an external process for RPC communication, including message handling, process control, and event streaming.

classes.name: piEvent
classes.description: Represents an event message received from the external process.

classes.name: agentEndPayload
classes.description: Payload structure for the end of agent communication, containing messages.

classes.name: rpcResponse
classes.description: Represents a response to an RPC command.

classes.name: agentMessage
classes.description: Represents a message from the agent, including role and content.

classes.name: contentBlock
classes.description: A block of content within a message, typically text.

methods.name: startDocsPiClient
methods.description: Initializes and starts the external documentation RPC client process.

methods.name: Prompt
methods.description: Sends a prompt message to the external process and waits for a response or completion.

methods.name: Stderr
methods.description: Returns the captured standard error output from the process.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the client process and cleans up resources.

methods.name: captureStderr
methods.description: Reads and stores the standard error output from the process.

methods.name: readStdout
methods.description: Reads and processes messages from the process's standard output.

methods.name: extractTranslationResult
methods.description: Extracts the translation or response text from the agent's end message.
